title: A.R.M.O.R. state of a relay of a node, as a device
description: What a node says about one of its relays on armor/device/{node_id}/{relay}/state: whether it is on (closed). The same relay says `online` or `offline` on armor/device/{node_id}/{relay}/availability and is told ON, OFF or TOGGLE on armor/device/{node_id}/{relay}/set (see validate_device_message).
